{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders (revenue = '999999.99')
qa_in_completed = completed_only[completed_only['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check their converted status
print(f'QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_in_completed)}')
print(f'QA orders converted status: {qa_in_completed["converted"].unique().tolist()}')

# Check if they are in any segment
print(f'QA orders by customer_segment: {qa_in_completed["customer_segment"].value_counts().to_dict()}')

# Remove QA orders from the completed set
clean_completed = completed_only[completed_only['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Compute conversion rate on clean data
conversion_rates_clean = clean_completed.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rates_clean['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates_clean['sum'] / conversion_rates_clean['count']
conversion_rates_clean_sorted = conversion_rates_clean.sort_values('conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Get the highest segment
highest_segment_clean = conversion_rates_clean_sorted.index[0]

# Output results
print(conversion_rates_clean_sorted)
print(f'Highest conversion rate segment (after removing QA orders): {highest_segment_clean}')"}
